def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    
    # Fix Category case variants - normalize to proper case
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].str.title()
    
    # Fix Region typos
    df['Region'] = df['Region'].replace({'Suoth': 'South', 'Eats': 'East'})
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Count orders per category
    result = df['Category'].value_counts().to_dict()
